scope: global (single price list, identical in every country)

pricing_model.schema: one global price list - identical in every country (no per-country pricing)

tiers.name: Free
tiers.mechanics: watch a short ad to unlock ~20 MB at basic speed (1 Mbps); data stacks and lasts 7 days
tiers.availability_note: available to users in North America, Europe & APAC per site copy

tiers.name: Classic
tiers.notes: high speed, no ads; pay only for the GB you need

tiers.name: Unlimited
tiers.notes: 5 GB at high speed per day, then 512 Kbps until next day/top-up; pausable
